causal_boundary: Receipt routes and temporal associations do not prove endogenous historical contagion.
historical_claim_boundary: Historical clusters are timestamp groupings and are not modeled newly-eligible waves.
loss_boundary: Uncovered debt + liquidated repayment is a composite model output, not realized economic loss and not market Expected Shortfall.
tail_boundary: 90%/95% liquidity haircuts are unobserved counterfactual tails.
